scope: Live desktop acceptance of the bar widget, the panel, the three store fetches, the link and notification paths. Portable checks are separate and are listed for completeness.
install: Local checkout symlinked at ~/.config/omarchy/plugins/salmun-nister.loot-drops, then omarchy-shell shell rescanPlugins and omarchy plugin enable salmun-nister.loot-drops right. A plain directory is sufficient; no git remote was needed.
commands: omarchy-notification-send --app-name 'Loot Drops' -g '󰜦' -u normal -t 12000 '<headline>' '<body>' --exec omarchy-shell -q salmun-nister.loot-drops open

results.check: Bar widget loads on the real bar
results.detail: Shell restart recorded the plugin loading with no Loot Drops errors. omarchy-shell shell listPlugins reports enabled:true for kinds ['bar-widget'].

results.check: Panel opens and renders the three stores
results.detail: Hero read 'Loot Drops' with the chest glyph over '4 FREE GAMES FROM STEAM, EPIC, AND GOG'. Steam listed Pony Island and Fireside Feelings; Epic Games listed Out of Sight and TerraScape; GOG showed its header row and nothing else. Captured from the live desktop as preview.png.

results.check: Empty store shows only its name
results.detail: GOG with no giveaway renders a bare header row, keeping its bell and switch, and no 'No giveaway running' line. The per-store state line was removed; it had been rendering unconditionally, which put '2 free games' over the first game of Steam's and Epic's lists.

results.check: Store marks are distinct and legible
results.detail: Steam U+F04D3, Epic U+F04DC (storefront), GOG U+F0BA1, verified in a magnified crop of preview.png at the 11px the panel draws them. The real Epic shield was tried and is unusable at that size: with its EPIC GAMES lettering it fills into a blob, and as a bare silhouette it is featureless. A test pins all three codepoints.

results.check: Hero is pinned and a fitting list does not scroll
results.detail: The hero sits outside the ListView so rows scroll beneath it. The harness asserts pinnedHeight is positive and that the hero's bottom edge equals the list's top edge, which fails if it is ever moved back to a header. flickableDirection is paired with interactive: contentHeight > height, so a list that fits cannot be moved by the wheel at all. The permanent few-pixel scroll range this fixed came from the subtitle wrapping and settling taller after the card had been sized.

The freshness text and both buttons read one footerInk value. They had drifted: the text was darkened while the buttons stayed at full foreground, which is what made the refresh glyph look brighter than the question mark beside it. Buttons hold that colour even when data goes stale; only the freshness text dims.

results.check: Game links open in the last used browser window
results.detail: Confirmed on the live desktop by the user. Rows hand the URL to xdg-open, which lets the browser pick its own window. They previously went through omarchy-launch-browser, whose trailing focus step selects by position in hyprctl's client array rather than focus order, so the tab landed in whichever browser window happened to be first; that array reshuffles as windows open and close.

Two toasts were fired through the real notificationArgs argv and confirmed on the live desktop by the user. The click action is omarchy-shell -q salmun-nister.loot-drops open, which opens the panel and clears the unseen dot through acknowledgeCurrent. Both sides read the target from Model.IPC_TARGET. A test asserts the argv carries no URL at all.

Steam search endpoint returned 2 rows; Epic freeGamesPromotions returned 2 zero-discount offers still inside their endDate; GOG giveaway/api/get returned 404, which the panel renders as an empty store rather than an error.

results.check: Private state file is created and readable
results.detail: ~/.local/state/salmun-nister.loot-drops created mode 0700 with seen.json mode 0600, containing per-store id baselines.

results.check: First fetch after install is silent
results.detail: The initial fetch recorded the Steam and Epic baselines and fired no notification, so installing does not announce games that were already free.

results.check: Desktop notification fires for a newly free game
results.detail: With the Steam baseline reduced to a single id, the next fetch produced a real desktop notification reading 'Fireside Feelings is free on Steam' with the Loot Drops app name and chest glyph.

results.check: Notification does not repeat for an unchanged list
results.detail: The baseline re-recorded the new id; a second refresh produced no further notification.

results.check: Switching a store off stops it and hides it
results.detail: With gogEnabled false the GOG section disappeared from the panel and no GOG request was made. Verified during development; not re-exercised after the hero, footer and pinned changes.

results.check: Muting a bell keeps the store listed but silent
results.detail: With epicNotify false the Epic Games section stayed in the panel with its games and showed a crossed-out bell, distinct from a disabled store. Verified during development; not re-exercised after the hero, footer and pinned changes.

results.check: Stale is derived from the refresh interval
results.detail: Stale was a fixed four-hour constant that only lined up with the old 180-minute default (1.33x). It is now 1.5x refreshMinutes, so it keeps meaning 'we may have missed something' at any interval: 45 minutes at the 30-minute floor, 135 at the 90-minute default, 18 hours at the 720 maximum. Unit-tested across those bounds, including that a single missed poll never reads stale and that an out-of-range interval cannot produce a threshold the settings slider disagrees with. Default interval moved 180 -> 90 and the range 5-180 -> 30-720, so the default no longer sits on the slider's ceiling.

40 model and helper tests, QML lint against the real Qt qmllint with no errors, the helper behaviour suite, and the offscreen harness (7 rows, all three store headers, pinned-hero assertion) all pass.

limitations: GOG's success path is fixture-only. No giveaway was running during acceptance, so the 200 response shape has not been observed live; the 404 empty path has.
No vertical bar was observed. The tested bar was horizontal (position top).

The derived stale threshold is unit-tested but was not observed live. Confirming it needs data 135 minutes old under a 90-minute interval, which was not waited out; the user confirmed the panel renders and behaves correctly with the new default instead.
Store switch and bell behaviour was verified during development and not re-exercised after the hero, footer, pinned-list, interval and stale changes.
preview.png shows the store data that was live at capture time and will not reflect what the panel shows later.

The notification click opens the panel rather than the store page, so no click-through to a store URL is exercised. That is the intended behaviour, but it means the notification path no longer covers URL opening; only the panel row does.
The documented install command 'omarchy plugin add <git-url>' was not exercised against a published repository at the time of recording; acceptance used a local symlink and a private GitHub remote.

omarchy-hyprland-focus-app still selects a window by position in hyprctl's client array rather than focus order. This plugin no longer depends on it, but other Omarchy panels and any notification that opens a URL still do. Already reported upstream.
